```{r}
#| cache: true
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)

hr_by_season <- Teams |>
	group_by(yearID) |>
	summarise(
		total_home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
		total_team_games = sum(G, na.rm = TRUE),
		.groups = "drop"
	) |>
	mutate(
		home_runs_per_game = total_home_runs / total_team_games,
		shortened_season = yearID %in% c(1918, 1919, 1981, 1994, 1995, 2020),
		season_type = if_else(shortened_season, "Shortened season", "Full season")
	)
```

```{r}
hr_by_season |>
	filter(yearID %in% c(1918, 1919, 1981, 1994, 1995, 2020)) |>
	arrange(yearID) |>
	print()

ggplot(hr_by_season, aes(x = yearID, y = home_runs_per_game)) +
	geom_line(color = "gray70") +
	geom_point(aes(color = season_type), size = 2.25) +
	scale_color_manual(
		values = c("Full season" = "gray40", "Shortened season" = "firebrick"),
		name = "Season type"
	) +
	labs(
		title = "Home runs per team-game by season",
		x = "Season",
		y = "Home runs per team-game",
		caption = "Shortened seasons are highlighted in red. Source: Lahman database."
	) +
	theme_minimal() +
	theme(
		legend.position = "bottom",
		plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
	)
```
